command:
set -euo pipefail
expected=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
[[ "$(hostname)" == andreas-MACO && "$(id -un)" == andreas ]] || exit 101
[[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$expected" ]] || { echo HEAD_MISMATCH >&2; exit 102; }
state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$state" == inactive || "$state" == failed ]] || { echo VM_NOT_INACTIVE >&2; exit 103; }
echo SELF_INTEGRATION_HEAD=$expected
echo SERVICE_STATE=$state
for spec in '/home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py|/usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py' '/home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/entityos-vm-semantic-cutover.conf|/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf'; do src=${spec%%|*}; live=${spec#*|}; echo PAIR_BEGIN=$src::$live; test -f "$src"; sudo -n test -f "$live"; s=$(sha256sum "$src"|awk '{print $1}'); l=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$live"|awk '{print $1}'); echo SOURCE_SHA256=$s; echo LIVE_SHA256=$l; if [ "$s" = "$l" ]; then echo EXACT_MATCH=1; else echo EXACT_MATCH=0; fi; echo PAIR_END; done
manifest=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json
sudo -n test -f "$manifest"
echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_SHA256=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$manifest"|awk '{print $1}')
sudo -n python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sqlite3, hashlib
m=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json')
d=json.loads(m.read_text())
print('CUTOVER_SCHEMA='+str(d.get('schema')))
print('CUTOVER_STAGED='+str(d.get('staged')))
for p in d.get('destinations',[]):
    q=pathlib.Path(p)
    print('DB_BEGIN='+str(q))
    print('SIZE='+str(q.stat().st_size))
    h=hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print('SHA256='+h)
    con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(q)+'?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
    try:
        r=con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
        print('INTEGRITY='+str(r))
    finally:
        con.close()
    print('DB_END='+str(q))
PY
echo EFFECTIVE_BEGIN
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ExecCondition -p DropInPaths --no-pager
echo EFFECTIVE_END
echo EXACT_SOURCE_READBACK_DONE=1
